holdings_basis: fictional long-only US equity portfolio; percentages of total economic exposure; not a real user account

cases.challenge: A holding exactly at the strict threshold is not a breach; distinguish position size from a claim that all 100% is direct crypto exposure.
Quantify the five-percentage-point policy excess without assuming a trade is authorized; connect the largest holding to source-backed operating risk.

Do not invent the remaining holdings or claim an exact tool risk score. Because unknown long-only holdings together total only 30% of total exposure, no one unknown holding can exceed the known 40% COIN position or the strict 50% limit; that narrow bound is logically knowable despite incomplete data.
